scope: Frozen workload/statistical design before candidate ASR inference; input manifest and runnable deployment configurations must be fixed before the first candidate measurement.

primary_model.precision: BF16 with specified FP32 accumulation and retained BF16 boundaries

reference.runnable_image_configuration: must be measured and recorded; source revision alone is insufficient

serving.flare: ignition export then separate flare run PACKAGE after preparer exit
serving.vllm: reasonably tuned compile, batching, CUDA graphs and caches; limitations retained; eager only if actual prepared graph failure is established

short_cells.load: saturated closed loop up to target outstanding count; every engine consumes the entire same frozen performance-inputs.json corpus exactly once, in its declared order
short_cells.stop_admitting: only after all fixed utterances have been admitted; drain every request
short_cells.elapsed: first timed send through final completion, including drain
short_cells.duration_qualification: each paired run must last at least300 seconds and complete at least100 requests; a shorter run is ineligible, never padded with idle time or repeated audio

cache_regimes.name: unique-content
cache_regimes.content: each distinct PCM at most once per timed run; fixed performance manifest order; disjoint from warmup and qualification PCM
cache_regimes.warmup: fixed development split, at least one full pass then 120 seconds and stable captured execution; all attempts retained
cache_regimes.cache: disable prefix and processor/encoder/feature reuse where supported; drain and reset all observable cache levels before timed run; actual encoder executions must confirm no reuse; unknown levels prevent equivalence claim
cache_regimes.exhaustion: the fixed complete corpus is not recycled; if any final paired run is shorter than300 seconds it is ineligible; no post-result sample replacement or renamed/repeated audio

cache_regimes.name: repeated-content
cache_regimes.content: a fixed request list of the same size as the unique-content corpus, cycling the256 development utterances in fixed manifest order; both engines consume every listed request once; same PCM warmup populates allowed caches
cache_regimes.cache: all implemented layered caches enabled; actual conditions and encoder work reported

cache_regimes.name: reasonable-deployment
cache_regimes.content: same complete fixed unique-content set and fixed mixed arrival schedule
cache_regimes.cache: each engine independently reasonable deployment settings; complete configurations and any non-equivalent cache conditions reported

mixed.short_content: first301 distinct utterances from the frozen unique manifest, in fixed order, one use per run
mixed.client_queue: bound actual short HTTP requests to4; latency begins at the scheduled arrival and includes client waiting for capacity, so backpressure cannot hide delay
mixed.long_content: each of the nine long-speech.json utterances once in listed order; repeated-content600s stress excluded
mixed.stop_admitting: after all301 short and9 long fixed scheduled requests; drain all requests
mixed.long_latency: all samples and count reported; nine requests do not establish a reliable P95

long_standalone.content: all nine annotated long utterances once per repetition
long_standalone.report: all samples, counts, makespan and complete ASR throughput; no reliable long P95 claim

blocks.independence: different time windows, fresh run/cache state; no compile, tuning or other GPU work during sampling; all warmups complete before each run
blocks.input_order: identical fixed complete request sets and parameters in each paired run; no engine-dependent duration prefix; statistical units are blocks, not individual requests or tokens

statistics.reference_estimate: geometric mean of the two bracketing vLLM run values in each block
statistics.throughput_ratio: fixed complete successful ASR audio seconds / full elapsed for each engine; divide Flare by the geometric mean of bracketing vLLM values
statistics.latency_ratio: flare per-run latency statistic divided by bracketing reference estimate
statistics.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Student t interval on five independent block log ratios, exponentiated
statistics.assumption: block log ratios are approximately normal; five blocks are a minimum design, not automatic precision qualification
statistics.primary_success: both B4 and B8 throughput ratio lower bounds >1, quality/lifecycle gates pass, and latency budgets pass
statistics.latency_budget: B1 mean and P95 latency, mixed short P95 and combined P95 upper ratio bounds <=1.05
statistics.no_optional_stopping: complete all five blocks, retain all attempts; no selection of fastest repeats; an inconclusive result is not a win; further qualification uses a separately frozen complete experiment

failures.timed: failed/truncated/nonfinite/empty-for-nonempty-reference requests retained, credited zero complete audio, invalidate the cell
failures.warmup: failed warmup retained and invalidates corresponding qualification attempt
failures.generated_tokens: actual engine counter, never retokenized cleaned text
failures.natural_vs_equal_tokens: natural complete ASR is primary; equal-token diagnostics separate

metrics: GPU activity intervals and available cache metrics

interpretation.shared_events: do not sum shared batch events per request
interpretation.overlap: do not sum overlapping stages as elapsed
interpretation.memory: allocated bytes are not physical DRAM; CPU/GPU share DRAM budget
interpretation.missing_metrics: null with reason, not fabricated zero

optimization: profile baseline first; independent ablations per major optimization; qualification against fixed model/numerical/workload protocol after final configuration freeze
